users: researchers and software maintainers integrating thermal-fluid research workflows
supported_tasks: validate discovery and repository-owned resource metadata
not_intended_for: a universal validated model, a field-ready diagnostic, a digital twin, or automatic physical validation
redistributing data, weights, or third-party software based solely on catalog metadata

required_inputs: task-appropriate split groups or result declarations

limitations: Structural validation does not establish data quality, physical applicability, model accuracy, or result reproducibility.
A resource manifest must be reviewed by the canonical repository maintainer before public portfolio indexing.
